title: The same eight responses, different denominators
method: Fictional invitation exercise: 8 responses / 10 invitations * 100 = 80%; 8 / 100 * 100 = 8%. The groups and values are invented to explain denominators, not observed participation or review quality.
alt: Illustrative response-rate chart: eight responses from ten invitations gives 80 percent; eight from one hundred gives 8 percent. No claim about response quality.
